memory_generations.comparison_scope: within-process current implementation: borrowed versus owned intake and direct versus file-backed memory-provider queries; no historical generation implementation baseline or generation speedup claim
memory_generations.intake_scope: source preparation includes caller vector/offset/reference assembly; intake starts after that preparation; owned intake consumes full capacity, borrowed intake copies native payloads
memory_generations.memory_scope: measured-session allocation owners and imported vector capacity; caller preparation, validation session, provider metadata/scratch and RSS excluded
memory_generations.segment_scope: memory-provider requests and returned bytes, not filesystem/device reads; ordinary direct query precedes explicit once-per-generation serialization
memory_generations.timing_scope: native-array return only; prepared-operation bind, scalar verification and result drop excluded; no total scalar-query claim
memory_generations.warmup_scope: reused providers, no cold-cache control; direct path also has one separately reported preconstruction correctness probe

evidence.scope:
Paired public native operator acceptance against an independent Python oracle.

The deterministic renamed-schema fixture checks operator semantics at requested
worker settings. Fresh-process timings include startup and complete output, but
exclude fixture preparation and Python validation. This bounded workload does
not establish production throughput, worker utilization, join coverage, or rank.
evidence.oracle: independent Python integer, set, grouping and ordering operations over generated rows; no external engine
evidence.float_contract: small integer sums exact in binary64; exact typed equality including averages; no tolerance
evidence.timing_boundary: native process creation through complete stdout and process exit; preparation and Python validation excluded
evidence.cpu_boundary: native child CPU work, which can overlap wall time
evidence.rss_boundary: per-native-child peak RSS; not allocator-reserved bytes
evidence.cache_policy: OS page cache uncontrolled; one immutable native artifact; fresh process for every query
evidence.worker_scope: requested worker ceilings; observed counters retained separately; no utilization or scaling claim
evidence.execution_evidence: selected bounded counters in summary; complete original envelope in verified gzip
evidence.ordering: sequential alternating baseline/candidate pairs; one warmup per case and worker setting

cases.name: metadata_count
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM heldout

cases.name: nullable_numeric_scalar
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(optional_units) AS present, SUM(optional_units) AS total, AVG(optional_units) AS average, MIN(optional_units) AS smallest, MAX(optional_units) AS largest FROM heldout

cases.name: exact_integer_extrema
cases.sql: SELECT MIN(exact_identifier) AS smallest, MAX(exact_identifier) AS largest FROM heldout

cases.name: scalar_distinct
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT category_text) AS labels, COUNT(DISTINCT optional_text) AS optional_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT unique_text) AS unique_labels FROM heldout

cases.name: numeric_group_sum
cases.sql: SELECT cohort_code, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(metric_units) AS total FROM heldout GROUP BY cohort_code

cases.name: skewed_string_count
cases.sql: SELECT category_text, COUNT(*) AS n FROM heldout GROUP BY category_text

cases.name: nullable_string_count
cases.sql: SELECT optional_text, COUNT(*) AS n FROM heldout GROUP BY optional_text

cases.name: composite_group
cases.sql: SELECT cohort_code, category_text, COUNT(*) AS n FROM heldout GROUP BY cohort_code, category_text

cases.name: compound_count_topk
cases.sql: SELECT cohort_code, category_text, COUNT(*) AS n FROM heldout GROUP BY cohort_code, category_text ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 12

cases.name: nullable_group_distinct
cases.sql: SELECT cohort_code, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT optional_text) AS different FROM heldout GROUP BY cohort_code

cases.name: utf8_byte_length
cases.sql: SELECT cohort_code, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(length(category_text)) AS bytes_total FROM heldout WHERE category_text <> '' GROUP BY cohort_code

evidence.scope:
Paired public native operator acceptance against an independent Python oracle.

The deterministic renamed-schema fixture checks operator semantics at requested
worker settings. Fresh-process timings include startup and complete output, but
exclude fixture preparation and Python validation. This bounded workload does
not establish production throughput, worker utilization, join coverage, or rank.
evidence.oracle: independent Python integer, set, grouping and ordering operations over generated rows; no external engine
evidence.float_contract: small integer sums exact in binary64; exact typed equality including averages; no tolerance
evidence.timing_boundary: native process creation through complete stdout and process exit; preparation and Python validation excluded
evidence.cpu_boundary: native child CPU work, which can overlap wall time
evidence.rss_boundary: per-native-child peak RSS; not allocator-reserved bytes
evidence.cache_policy: OS page cache uncontrolled; one immutable native artifact; fresh process for every query
evidence.worker_scope: requested worker ceilings; observed counters retained separately; no utilization or scaling claim
evidence.execution_evidence: selected bounded counters in summary; complete original envelope in verified gzip
evidence.ordering: sequential alternating baseline/candidate pairs; one warmup per case and worker setting
